1.consolidated_definition: vulg. Ahora. “Agora le jablo claro.” , p. 138. (Pertenece a los períodos ante-clásico y clásico. Muy usado en el Romancero y el Mio Cid). 1.en_consolidated_definition: Now. "Agora le jablo claro," p. 138. (Belongs to the pre-classical and classical periods. Very used in the Romancero and El Mio Cid). (For Ac., it is a poetic modern adverb or conjunction of use. As a historical curiosity, we recall that our first poetess, Doña Bibiana Benítez used the license in her verses To Old Age: "Why did you give me these things - If now you are taking them away from me?" But currently, it is only an unfortunate colloquialism.
